first_meeting.text: Welcome to the [color=#FFD700]Leximancer's Tower[/color], young one.
first_meeting.speaker: Owly

first_meeting.text: I am [color=#FFA500]Owly[/color]. I've been waiting for someone like you.
first_meeting.speaker: Owly

first_meeting.text: The master disappeared long ago. Only [color=#00FF00]words[/color] remain.
first_meeting.speaker: Owly

first_meeting.text: The tower responds to [color=#FF6B6B]language[/color]. Collect the spell fragments, and the path will open.
first_meeting.speaker: Owly

first_meeting.text: Let me guide you. Press [color=#87CEEB]E[/color] to interact with objects around you.
first_meeting.speaker: Owly

hint_door.text: That door is sealed. It needs a [color=#FFD700]KEY[/color] and the right [color=#FF6B6B]spell[/color].
hint_door.speaker: Owly

hint_door.text: Look around the hall. The master always left clues on the walls.
hint_door.speaker: Owly

hint_torch.text: The torch is cold. Try a spell that brings [color=#FFA500]light[/color] or [color=#FF4500]fire[/color].
hint_torch.speaker: Owly

hint_torch.text: Have you found the [color=#FFD700]LIGHT[/color] fragment yet?
hint_torch.speaker: Owly

greeting.text: Oh, a visitor! It's been so [color=#87CEEB]long[/color] since anyone came to my kitchen...
greeting.speaker: Ghost Chef

greeting.text: I want to bake a [color=#FFB6C1]CAKE[/color], but I forgot the recipe. Can you help?
greeting.speaker: Ghost Chef

greeting.text: The ingredients are in the cupboards. Find them!
greeting.speaker: Ghost Chef

hint_cupboard.text: The cupboards are labeled in [color=#87CEEB]English[/color]. Can you read them?
hint_cupboard.speaker: Ghost Chef

hint_cupboard.text: I need [color=#FFD700]MILK[/color], [color=#FFD700]EGG[/color], and [color=#FFD700]FLOUR[/color]. The others are just for show.
hint_cupboard.speaker: Ghost Chef

success.text: You did it! Here's the [color=#FFD700]stair key[/color] as promised.
success.speaker: Ghost Chef

success.text: Good luck on the next floor, young [color=#00FF00]Leximancer[/color]!
success.speaker: Ghost Chef
